title: Orient Cables (India) IPO Details
intro:
Orient Cables IPO is a book build issue of ₹552.00 crores. The issue is a combination of fresh issue of 1.18 crore shares aggregating to ₹320.00 crores and offer for sale of 85.29 lakh shares aggregating to ₹232.00 crores.

Orient Cables IPO opens for subscription on Sep 25, 2026 and closes on Sep 29, 2026. The allotment for the Orient Cables IPO is expected to be finalized on Sep 30, 2026. Orient Cables IPO will list on NSE and BSE with a tentative listing date fixed as Oct 5, 2026.

Orient Cables IPO is set issue price band at ₹258 to ₹272 per share. The lot size for an application is 55 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹14,960 (55 shares) (based on upper price).

IIFL Capital Services Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Kfin Technologies Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.

Refer to Orient Cables IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in September 2005, Orient Cables (India) Limited is a manufacturer of networking cables and passive networking equipment. The Company has nearly two decades of experience in the networking cables and passive networking equipment industry and caters to industries including broadband, telecommunications, data centres, renewable energy, smart building automation and security, system integration, FMEG and automotive.

Its product portfolio includes CAT5, CAT5e, CAT6 and CAT6A networking cables, patch cords, CCTV and coaxial cables, instrumentation and control cables, power cables, optical fibre cables, fibre patch cords, keystone jacks, power strips and power cords. The Company also manufactures customized products based on customer requirements.

As of June 30, 2026, the Company had an installed capacity of 895,776 km. It has also expanded its product portfolio into E-beam irradiated specialty cables, solar junction boxes, tethered drone systems, cable harnesses, power cords and EV charging cables and guns. Its EV charging cables are TÜV certified.

According to the 1Lattice Report, the Company was among the top four networking cable players in India, with a market share of approximately 22.9% in Fiscal 2026, compared with approximately 16% in Fiscal 2022. The Company serves customers across telecom, broadband, data centres, renewable energy, e-mobility, FMEG, smart homes and offices, security and surveillance, railways, defence and aerospace.
As of June 30, 2026, the Company had 613 permanent employees and 1,327 contractual employees.
strengths: Established presence in the networking cables industry.
Focus on product innovation and new product development.
Diversified portfolio of networking and specialty cable products.

faqs.question: How to apply in Orient Cables IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Orient Cables IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Orient Cables IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Orient Cables IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Orient Cables IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: When Orient Cables IPO will open?
faqs.answer: The Orient Cables IPO opens on Fri, Sep 25, 2026 and closes on Tue, Sep 29, 2026.

faqs.question: What is the lot size of Orient Cables IPO?
faqs.answer: Orient Cables IPO lot size is 55 , and the minimum amount required for application is ₹14,960 .

faqs.question: How to apply for Orient Cables IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Orient Cables IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is Orient Cables IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Orient Cables IPO will be done on Wednesday, September 30, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Thu, Oct 1, 2026 . Check the Orient Cables IPO allotment status .

faqs.question: When is Orient Cables IPO listing date ?
faqs.answer: The Orient Cables IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Mon, Oct 5, 2026 .
